Here we discuss our individual patient's problems through series of inputs from the available global online community of experts intending to solve those patients clinical problems with the collective current best evidence-based inputs. This e-log book also reflects my patient-centred online learning portfolio and your valuable inputs on the comment box are welcome.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EI've been given this case to solve in an attempt to understand the topic of \"patient clinical data analysis\" to develop my competency in reading and comprehending clinical data including history, clinical findings, investigations, and come up with a diagnosis and treatment plan.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"post-header\" style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; Drinks tea at 7 am followed by breakfast ( rice with curry) at 9 am. Leaves home for work( works as Shepard) at 9am and works till 7 pm. In between eats lunch at 2 pm and drinks tea at 5 pm. Eats dinner at 8 pm and sleeps at 9 pm.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPAST HISTORY:\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENot a k\/c\/o Dm, Htn, asthma, Epilepsy, thyroid disorders, cad, cvs\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHad similar complaints 1 year back - went to the hospital with abdominal pain and was diagnosed as jaundice for which he was treated.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESURGICAL HISTORY:\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EOperated for B\/l hydrocele and hernia 20 years back.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPERSONAL HISTORY:\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EDiet: Mixed\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAppetite: decreased\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESleep: Adequate\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EBowel and bladder movements: Regular\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAddictions:\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAlcohol consumption since 45 years every day and occasionally since 10 years.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESmoking since 40 years stopped 1 year back.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EGENERAL EXAMINATION:\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPatient is conscious,coherent,cooperative\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo pallor, icterus, cyanosis, clubbing, lymphadenopathy, pedal edema.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETemp:97.8F\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EBp:120\/80 mm Hg\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ERr:18 cpm\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPr:81 bpm\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both;
